title: SIRT investigates death of man in Amherst police custody
article: The Serious Incident Response Team will conduct a review after the death of a man who was taken into custody by Amherst police.
According to the Amherst Police Department, on June 29 they took an adult male to their cells who had been found on Willow Street and was thought to be intoxicated.
"While being monitored, it was noted that his condition was not improving and Emergency Health services were contacted," reads a release put out by the Amherst Police.
EHS took the man to the Cumberland Regional Health Centre where he died due to a "medical issue."
